column1: # mapping_set_title: Semantic mappings of measurement concepts in contextual indicators to Wikidata

# mapping_set_description: Manually curated mappings from measurement concepts used in contextual indicators and derived calculations to Wikidata entities used as codings in the FHIR RDF representation.

column17: FHIR Observation.component.code as CodeableConcept . In our data sources, weather observations (e.g., temperature) refer to measurements for a specific time point or time period, whereas the mapped Wikidata concepts represent the corresponding weather variables independently of any specific temporal context.

FHIR Observation.code as CodeableConcept.Traffic safety is derived from aggregated road traffic incidents in our data sources, while the mapped Wikidata concept has a broader scope covering safety across multiple transport modes, including road, rail, and air transport.
